title: Sports club facilities
source_note: Original ForLanguage content informed by recurring sports and club-service themes in user-provided recent-review materials; no recalled prompt copied verbatim.

tasks.prompt: You have joined a local sports club. Reply briefly to five member messages.
questions: Do you prefer indoor or outdoor sport?
What time do you usually train?

tasks.prompt: The club is buying new equipment. Write a short message suggesting one item that would be useful to members.
Members are discussing how the club should use its limited budget.
questions: Should the club spend more on equipment or longer opening hours?
Which facility is most important for beginners?
How could the club keep membership affordable while covering higher costs?

tasks.prompt: The sports club announces shorter weekend opening hours and a separate charge for borrowing some equipment. Write to a friend about your reaction.
Write a formal email to the sports club manager about the shorter weekend hours and equipment charge. Explain how these changes may affect members and propose two fair alternatives.
